performanceSnapshot: Nov 16 to Nov 22: 31 form fills, 39 leads and 4 booked appointments on $874 spent. That's $28.20 per form fill, $22.41 per lead and $218.53 per appointment.
The prior week (Nov 9 to 15) was 43 form fills, 2 leads and no appointments on $834 spent: $19.39 per form fill and $416.98 per lead. Leads rose from 2 to 39 and cost per lead fell 95%.
Cost per form fill went up because the new lead campaign's page doesn't record form starts. Its 31 leads count as leads but not as form fills.

A testimonial video campaign (A | Video Views | 11/16) launched on $5 a day, shown to men 25 to 65 outside Kansas City and Dallas.
